title: Onboarding
intro: Work top to bottom. Tick each step as you finish it — your progress is saved in this browser, and the panel on the right is the same list as a file you can commit.

steps.title: Raise the onboarding request ticket
steps.detail: One ticket per product. The platform team picks it up within two working days.

steps.title: Request write access to your product repository
steps.detail: You need this before any of the files below can be pushed.

steps.title: Bootstrap your local checkout
steps.detail: Installs the toolchain and runs the same checks CI does.

steps.title: Commit config.yaml for your tenant
steps.detail: Fill it in on the Tenant Config tab, then push it with the link there.

steps.title: Verify the pipeline runs green end to end
steps.detail: Push a no-op commit and confirm build, test and deploy all pass.

steps.title: Ask your platform contact to sign the onboarding off
